listing.name: Phantasy Star Universe (Xbox 360) — Phantasy Star Universe Recompiled (experimental) (DanielCoffey1)
listing.summary: The project reports chapter 1’s initial combat, NPC interactions and save reload. Later progression is untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Phantasy Star Universe (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. USA/Europe; story-cutscene fix requires GPU ROV.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the experimental Windows installer with your own USA or European Phantasy Star Universe ISO. It checks and extracts the image and prepares the runtime. Whether setup generates game code locally has not been confirmed.

warnings: The project reports chapter 1’s initial combat, NPC interactions and save reload. Later progression is untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
